assertions.predicate: After merge and deployment, the registered app observer verifies that the production app release source commit contains this PR's merge commit. Release ancestry alone does not prove CI evidence retention.
assertions.expected_result: The observer records verified production app release ancestry. This assertion remains unproven until that observation runs.
assertions.input_class: read-only public app release identity and immutable app Git history

assertions.predicate: As an explicit pending observation step of the app runner, a reviewer reads a later CI push run on main containing this PR's merge commit, at run_attempt 1. The run retains four browser-results artifacts and one browser-coverage artifact for 14 days. Each artifact identity binds the same tested SHA, run ID and attempt 1. The shard artifacts retain planned manifests, native per-file JUnit and start/exit evidence. The coverage decision reports no errors and one passing observation for every required critical scenario. Missing, duplicate, unsuccessful or rerun-only evidence fails this observation. Read metadata and bounded receipt summaries only; if the budget cannot establish every condition, leave the observation pending.
assertions.expected_result: A read-only reviewer records the main run URL, tested SHA, run ID, attempt 1, artifact IDs, retention metadata and coverage summary. The app runner's automatic release check cannot establish this condition; its explicit observation step stays pending until that evidence is inspected. No existing PR run or synthetic receipt is claimed as main execution proof.
assertions.input_class: read-only GitHub CI metadata and retained first-attempt receipt summaries; explicit pending observation step
